implement.name: Kotlin DSL over Groovy
implement.summary: Build scripts are .gradle.kts; a .gradle Groovy file is named as a finding

implement.name: Versions live in the catalog
implement.summary: Every plugin and library version is declared in gradle/libs.versions.toml; a literal version in a build script is a finding

implement.name: Convention plugin shape
implement.summary: Shared build logic lives in a build-logic composite as a precompiled script plugin, applied via plugins { id("...") } — the Kotlin Multiplatform-shaped convention plugin belongs to scrumia-kotlin-multiplatform-mobile

implement.name: Tasks are registered, not created
implement.summary: Tasks use tasks.register for lazy evaluation; an eager tasks.create is a finding unless the comment states why

implement.name: Caches on by default
implement.summary: org.gradle.caching=true and org.gradle.configuration-cache=true are set in gradle.properties; each rule names what it breaks when enabled

implement.name: Composite builds for local siblings
implement.summary: A locally-built sibling dependency is wired via includeBuild(...); publishing one to a Maven snapshot for internal use is a finding

implement.name: Plugin versions in pluginManagement
implement.summary: Every plugin version is declared in settings.gradle.kts's pluginManagement block; a plugins { id("...") version "..." } in a build script is a finding

implement.name: Documentation tasks wired into the lifecycle
implement.summary: dokka, javadoc or a publishing convention plugin hooks into check or build; the rule is the wiring, not the content of the docs

review.name: Build script format
review.summary: A .gradle Groovy file is the trigger; named as a finding the audit cites

review.name: Version literals outside the catalog
review.summary: A version string in build.gradle.kts that should have been in libs.versions.toml

review.name: Eager task creation without a stated reason
review.summary: tasks.create with no comment naming why the eager form is correct

review.name: Plugin versions declared in the wrong place
review.summary: A plugins { id("...") version "..." } block in a build script is the version literal that belongs in pluginManagement

review.name: Locally-published snapshot instead of includeBuild
review.summary: A dependency on a Maven snapshot that came from a sibling checkout is the dependency that should have used includeBuild

review.name: Documentation tasks not wired in
review.summary: A dokka or javadoc task that exists but is not a dependency of check or build

review.name: Gradle audit
review.summary: Measure an existing Gradle project against the eight rules — find each .gradle, each literal version, each eager create, each missing cache flag

find-spec.name: Where the Gradle rules live
find-spec.summary: The eight Gradle rules are documented in plugins/scrumia-gradle/skills/scrumia-gradle/guides/ — load them when a ticket touches build scripts, version catalogs, convention plugins, task configuration, caches, composite builds, pluginManagement or documentation tasks
